name: Sales Rep Bot - Main (Telegram) v2 (Gemini + multi-tenant)

parameters.jsCode:
// ===== EDIT THESE VALUES FOR EACH CLIENT COPY =====
const cfg = {
  supabase_url: 'https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co',
  supabase_key: 'YOUR_SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY',   // sb_secret_...  (legacy: service_role). NEVER use the publishable/anon key here
  bot_token: 'YOUR_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN',
  gemini_key: 'YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY',          // from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
  // Models are tried in order until one works (Google retires models on a schedule: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models)
  llm_models: ['gemini-3.8-flash', 'gemini-4-argon'],      // text extraction / drafting (JSON output)
  vision_models: ['gemini-3.8-flash', 'gemini-4-argon'],   // invoice photos: the two models cross-check each other
  stt_model: 'gemini-3.5-transcribe',                      // voice -> text (falls back to llm_models if this one fails)
  business: 'a distributor selling products to shops',   // one line describing what you sell (helps the AI)
  price_tolerance_pct: 20,    // a price this far from the catalog list price triggers a warning
  check_custody: true,        // warn when a rep sells more than he holds
  require_catalog: false,     // true = a product that is not in the catalog blocks the confirmation
  timezone: 'Africa/Cairo',
  currency: 'EGP',
  location_max_age_min: 30,   // location older than this = rep must resend it
  max_voice_seconds: 240,
  draft_reminder_window: [8, 22], // unconfirmed-draft reminders are sent only between these local hours
  debug: true                 // true = error details are sent to the chat (set false in production)
};
return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: Object.assign({}, i.json, { cfg }) }));
